```{r}
# WD 
wd <- function(path = NULL) {
  
  if (!requireNamespace("here", quietly = TRUE)) {
    stop("Package 'here' is required. Install it with install.packages('here').")
  }
  
  if (!is.null(path)) {
    
    path <- path.expand(path)
    
    if (dir.exists(path)) {
      
      # définit le projet racine implicitement si possible
      setwd(normalizePath(path))
      message("Using path: ", normalizePath(path))
      return(invisible(path))
      
    } else {
      warning("Path does not exist: ", path)
    }
  }
  
  choice <- readline(
    "Directory not found or not provided. Type 'f' (choose folder) or 'c' (current project root): "
  )
  
  choice <- tolower(choice)
  
  if (choice == "f") {
    
    new_path <- dirname(file.choose())
    
    setwd(normalizePath(new_path))
    message("Selected folder: ", new_path)
    return(invisible(new_path))
    
  } else if (choice == "c") {
    
    root <- here::here()
    setwd(normalizePath(root))
    message("Using here() project root: ", root)
    return(invisible(root))
    
  } else {
    stop("Invalid option")
  }
}
```

```{r}
plot2pdf <- function(plot, file, width = 15, height = 7) {
  pdf(file, width = width, height = height)
  print(plot)
  invisible(dev.off())
}

set.seed(123)

jours <- paste0("Batch ", 1:4)
traitements <- c("Blank","Trich.","Rhizo.","Trich. × Rhizo.")

rep_mat <- matrix(
  c(3,3,2,2,
    2,3,3,2,
    2,2,3,3,
    3,2,2,3),
  nrow = 4,
  byrow = TRUE
)

positions <- expand.grid(row = 1:2, col = 1:5)

  trt <- rep(traitements, times = rep_mat[i, ])
```

#=== ANOVA
```{r} 
# =========================
# FUNCTION
# =========================

run_unblock <- function(data, response, output_name, factors, outdir, tukey_padding = 0.10){

  # =========================
  # MODEL 
  # =========================
  formula <- as.formula(
    paste(response, "~", paste(factors, collapse = " * "))
  )
  interaction_term <- paste(factors, collapse = ":")
  model <- aov(formula, data = data)

  # =========================
  # ANOVA TABLE
  # =========================
  anova_table <- broom::tidy(model)
  write.csv(
    anova_table,
    paste0(outdir, "/Tables/ANOVA_", output_name, ".csv"),
    row.names = FALSE
  )
  
  # =========================
  # PARTIAL ETA SQUARED
  # =========================
  ss <- anova(model)[, "Sum Sq"]
  ss_error <- ss[length(ss)]

  eta_df <- data.frame(
    Effect = rownames(anova(model))[1:(length(ss)-1)],
    partial_eta_sq = ss[1:(length(ss)-1)] / (ss[1:(length(ss)-1)] + ss_error)
  )

  write.csv(
    eta_df,
    paste0(outdir, "/Tables/EtaSq_", output_name, ".csv"),
    row.names = FALSE
  )

  # simple plot (parcimonieux)
  pdf(paste0(outdir, "/Plots/EtaSq_", output_name, ".pdf"))
  barplot(
    eta_df$partial_eta_sq,
    names.arg = eta_df$Effect,
    ylim = c(0, 1),
    ylab = expression(eta[p]^2),
    main = paste("Partial eta squared -", output_name)
  )
  dev.off()

  # =========================
  # DESCRIPTIVE STATISTICS
  # =========================
  descriptive_df <- data %>%
    group_by(across(all_of(factors))) %>%
    summarise(
      n = dplyr::n(),
      Mean = mean(.data[[response]], na.rm = TRUE),
      SD = sd(.data[[response]], na.rm = TRUE),
      SE = SD / sqrt(n),
      t_value = qt(0.975, df = n - 1),
      CI95_low = Mean - t_value * SE,
      CI95_high = Mean + t_value * SE,
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(-t_value)

  write.csv(
    descriptive_df,
    paste0(outdir, "/Tables/Descriptive_", output_name, ".csv"),
    row.names = FALSE
  )

  # =========================
  # ASSUMPTIONS
  # =========================
  shapiro_res <- shapiro.test(residuals(model))

  levene_res <- car::leveneTest(formula, data = data)

  capture.output(
    shapiro_res,
    file = paste0(outdir, "/Tables/Shapiro_", output_name, ".txt")
  )

  write.csv(
    as.data.frame(levene_res),
    paste0(outdir, "/Tables/Levene_", output_name, ".csv"),
    row.names = FALSE
  )

  # =========================
  # QQ PLOT
  # =========================
  pdf(paste0(outdir, "/Plots/QQplot_", output_name, ".pdf"))

  qqnorm(
    residuals(model),
    main = paste("QQ plot residuals -", output_name)
  )
  qqline(residuals(model), col = "red")

  dev.off()

  # =========================
  # TUKEY #TODO: modify to only do it when P_val is significativ
  # =========================
  p_vals <- anova(model)[, "Pr(>F)"]
  is_significant <- any(p_vals < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE)

  if(is_significant){

    tuk <- TukeyHSD(model)

    write.csv(
      as.data.frame(tuk[[interaction_term]]),
      paste0(outdir, "/Tables/Tukey_", output_name, ".csv")
    )

    letters <- multcompLetters4(model, tuk)

    letters_df <- data.frame(
      Interaction = names(letters[[interaction_term]]$Letters),
      Letters = letters[[interaction_term]]$Letters
    )

    # positions for plot (dynamic response)
    data$Interaction <- do.call(interaction, c(data[factors], sep = ":"))
    ypos <- data %>%
      group_by(Interaction) %>%
      summarise(
        ypos = max(.data[[response]]) + tukey_padding * diff(range(.data[[response]])),
        .groups = "drop"
      )

    letters_df <- left_join(letters_df, ypos, by = "Interaction")
    letters_df$Tissue <- output_name

    write.csv(
      letters_df,
      paste0(outdir, "/Tables/Letters_", output_name, ".csv"),
      row.names = FALSE
    )

  } else {

    tuk <- NULL

    letters_df <- data.frame(
      Interaction = NA,
      Letters = NA,
      ypos = NA,
      Tissue = output_name
    )
  }
  # =========================
  # RETURN
  # =========================
  return(list(
    model = model,
    tukey = tuk,
    letters = letters_df,
    eta_sq = eta_df
  ))
}

plot_violin_unblock <- function(
    data,
    model,
    response,
    ylabel,
    letters_df,
    treatment_colors = NULL,
    facet_var = NULL,
    facet_direction = c("rows", "cols"),
    treatment_labels = NULL,   # ex: c(Volume = "mL", MS = "MS strength")
    level_labels = NULL,       # ex: c(Prs = "+", Abs = "-")
    padding_label = c(0.03, 0.20),
    p_adj = NULL
){

  anova_res <- summary(model)[[1]][1:3, ]

  if (is.null(p_adj)) {

    # standard ANOVA p-values
    p_values <- anova_res[, "Pr(>F)"]

  } else {

    # use FDR-corrected values
    if (!"FDR" %in% colnames(p_adj)) {
      stop("p_adj doit contenir une colonne 'FDR'")
    }

    p_values <- p_adj[
      rownames(anova_res),
      "FDR"
    ]

  }

  p_label <- paste0(
    stringr::str_pad(trimws(rownames(anova_res)), width = max(nchar(trimws(rownames(anova_res)))), side  = "right"),
    ": p = ",
    signif(p_values, 3),
    collapse = "\n"
  )

  factors      <- attr(terms(model), "term.labels")
  main_factors <- factors[!grepl(":", factors)] 
  x_label      <- paste(main_factors, collapse = " × ")

  # --- Detect an empty / non-significant letters_df (all NA) ---
  if (!is.null(letters_df)) {
    if (nrow(letters_df) == 0 || all(is.na(letters_df$Interaction))) {
      letters_df <- NULL
    }
  }

  # --- Enrich letters_df with facet_var if absent ---
  if (!is.null(facet_var) && !is.null(letters_df) && !facet_var %in% colnames(letters_df)) {

    interaction_facet_map <- data %>%
      dplyr::select(dplyr::all_of(c("Interaction", facet_var))) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(dplyr::across(everything(), as.character)) %>%
      dplyr::distinct()

    letters_df <- letters_df %>%
      dplyr::mutate(Interaction = as.character(Interaction)) %>%
      dplyr::left_join(interaction_facet_map, by = "Interaction")
  }

  # --- Filter letters_df: keep only interactions from the correct facet ---
  if (!is.null(facet_var) && !is.null(letters_df) && facet_var %in% colnames(letters_df)) {
    letters_df <- letters_df %>%
      dplyr::filter(
        as.character(.data[[facet_var]]) ==
          as.character(data[[facet_var]][match(Interaction, data$Interaction)])
      )
  }

  # --- helper: escape sensitive markdown characters (avoids <ul> bug) ---
  escape_md <- function(x) {
    gsub("([*+_#-])", "\\\\\\1", x)
  }

  # --- helper: apply level_labels to a raw value if provided ---
  apply_level_label <- function(x) {
    if (is.null(level_labels)) return(x)
    out <- as.character(x)
    matched <- out %in% names(level_labels)
    out[matched] <- level_labels[out[matched]]
    out <- escape_md(out)
    out
  }

   # --- X-axis label: keep only the factor NOT used as facet_var ---
  # main_factors is in the same order as the parts of Interaction (separated by ":")
  axis_factor <- if (!is.null(facet_var) && facet_var %in% main_factors) {
    setdiff(main_factors, facet_var)
  } else {
    main_factors
  }

  if (!is.null(facet_var) && length(main_factors) == 2 && facet_var %in% main_factors) {

    facet_pos <- which(main_factors == facet_var)
    axis_pos  <- setdiff(seq_along(main_factors), facet_pos)

    data <- data %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        .axis_value = sapply(
          strsplit(as.character(Interaction), ":"),
          function(x) x[axis_pos]
        )
      )

    # --- apply level_labels (e.g. Prs -> +) BEFORE the treatment_labels suffix ---
    data <- data %>%
      dplyr::mutate(.axis_value = apply_level_label(.axis_value))

    # apply custom label (e.g. "*T. asperellum*") if provided — markdown allowed
    axis_suffix <- if (!is.null(treatment_labels) && axis_factor %in% names(treatment_labels)) {
      treatment_labels[[axis_factor]]
    } else {
      ""
    }

    data <- data %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        .axis_label = paste0(.axis_value, ifelse(axis_suffix == "", "", paste0(" ", axis_suffix)))
      )

    # order x-axis labels according to the order of appearance of Interaction
    axis_order <- data %>%
      dplyr::distinct(Interaction, .axis_label) %>%
      dplyr::arrange(Interaction) %>%
      dplyr::pull(.axis_label) %>%
      unique()

    data$.axis_label <- factor(data$.axis_label, levels = axis_order)

    x_aes_var <- ".axis_label"

  } else {
    x_aes_var <- "Interaction"
  }

  # --- adaptive plot height #TODO: fix bug "Removed 1 row containing missing values or values outside the scale range (`geom_point()`). -> when point outside of scale range, force the plot and increase the scale-range"
  # Determine the maximum height to display
  ymax_data <- max(data[[response]], na.rm = TRUE)

  if (!is.null(letters_df)) {
    ymax_letters <- max(letters_df$ypos, na.rm = TRUE)
    ymax <- max(ymax_data, ymax_letters)
  } else {
    ymax <- ymax_data
  }

  ymin   <- min(data[[response]], na.rm = TRUE)
  yrange <- ymax - ymin
  padding <- padding_label[1] * yrange

  p <- ggplot(
    data,
    aes(x = .data[[x_aes_var]], y = .data[[response]], fill = Interaction)
  ) +
    geom_boxplot(width = 0.15, outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0) +
    geom_jitter(
      aes(color = Interaction),
      width = 0.12, alpha = 0.7, size = 4, show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(ymin, ymax + padding_label[2] * yrange + padding), expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0))) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 20) +    # --- taille de base augmentée pour PowerPoint ---
    theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      axis.text.x  = ggtext::element_markdown(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 24),
      axis.text.y  = element_text(size = 24),
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 26, face = "bold"),
      axis.title.x = if (!is.null(facet_var)) element_blank() else element_text(size = 26, face = "bold"),
      strip.text   = ggtext::element_markdown(size = 24, face = "bold")
    ) +
    labs(
      x = if (!is.null(facet_var)) NULL else paste0("Treatment (", x_label, ")"),
      y = ylabel
    )

  # --- Tukey letters ---
  if (!is.null(letters_df)) {

    if (x_aes_var == ".axis_label") {
      letters_df <- letters_df %>%
        dplyr::left_join(
          data %>% dplyr::distinct(Interaction, .axis_label),
          by = "Interaction"
        )
      p <- p + geom_text(
        data = letters_df,
        aes(x = .axis_label, y = ypos, label = Letters),
        inherit.aes = FALSE,
        size = 7
      )
    } else {
      p <- p + geom_text(
        data = letters_df,
        aes(x = Interaction, y = ypos, label = Letters),
        inherit.aes = FALSE,
        size = 7
      )
    }
  }

  # --- Colors ---
  if (!is.null(treatment_colors)) {
    p <- p +
      scale_color_manual(values = treatment_colors) +
      scale_fill_manual(values  = treatment_colors)
  }

  # --- Facet + P-val ---
  facet_direction <- match.arg(facet_direction)

  if (!is.null(facet_var)) {

    # build custom labels for the facet strip
    facet_levels_raw <- sort(unique(as.character(data[[facet_var]])))

     # --- apply level_labels (e.g. Prs -> +) to the facet value, escaped ---
    facet_levels_display <- apply_level_label(facet_levels_raw)

    if (!is.null(treatment_labels) && facet_var %in% names(treatment_labels)) {
      facet_suffix  <- treatment_labels[[facet_var]]
      facet_labeller <- setNames(
        paste0(facet_levels_display, " ", facet_suffix),
        facet_levels_raw
      )
    } else {
      facet_labeller <- setNames(facet_levels_display, facet_levels_raw)
    }

    if (facet_direction == "rows") {
      p <- p + facet_grid(
        rows = vars(.data[[facet_var]]),
        scales = "free_x",
        space = "free_x",
        labeller = labeller(.rows = facet_labeller)
      )
    } else {
      p <- p + facet_grid(
        cols = vars(.data[[facet_var]]),
        scales = "free_x",
        space = "free_x",
        labeller = labeller(.cols = facet_labeller)
      )
    }

    first_facet <- facet_levels_raw[1]

    ann_df <- data.frame(label = p_label, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    ann_df[[facet_var]] <- first_facet

    p <- p + geom_label(
      data = ann_df,
      aes(label = label),
      x = -Inf,
      y = Inf,
      hjust = -0.05,
      vjust = 1.1,
      size = 7,            # --- enlarged for PowerPoint ---
      fill = "white",
      alpha = 0.9
    )

  } else {

    p <- p + annotate(
      "label",
      x = -Inf, y = Inf,
      label = p_label,
      hjust = -0.05, vjust = 1.1,
      size  = 7,
      fill  = "white",
      alpha = 0.9
    )
  }

  return(p)
}

run <- function(data, response, output_name, factors, outdir, tukey_padding = 0.10){

  # =========================
  # MODEL 
  # =========================
  factors_formula <- paste(factors, collapse = " * ")
  interaction_term <- paste(factors_formula, collapse = ":")

  if ("Block" %in% names(data)) {
    formula_txt <- paste(response, "~", interaction_term, "+ Block")
    formula <- as.formula(formula_txt)
  } else {
    formula_txt <- paste(response, "~", interaction_term)
    formula <- as.formula(formula_txt)
  }
  
  formula_factors <- as.formula(paste(response, "~", interaction_term))

  model <- aov(formula, data = data)

  # =========================
  # ANOVA TABLE
  # =========================
  anova_table <- broom::tidy(model)
  write.csv(
    anova_table,
    paste0(outdir, "/Tables/ANOVA_", output_name, ".csv"),
    row.names = FALSE
  )
  
  # =========================
  # PARTIAL ETA SQUARED
  # =========================

  anova_table <- anova(model)

  ss <- anova_table[, "Sum Sq"]
  terms <- rownames(anova_table)

  # Residual sum of squares
  ss_error <- ss[terms == "Residuals"]

  # Keep only experimental terms present in the model
  experimental_terms <- factors[
    factors %in% terms
  ]

  # Get their row positions
  effect_idx <- match(experimental_terms, terms)

  eta_df <- data.frame(
    Effect = experimental_terms,
    partial_eta_sq =
      ss[effect_idx] /
      (ss[effect_idx] + ss_error)
  )

  write.csv(
    eta_df,
    paste0(outdir, "/Tables/EtaSq_", output_name, ".csv"),
    row.names = FALSE
  )

  # =========================
  # SIMPLE PLOT
  # =========================

  pdf(
   paste0(
      outdir,
      "/Plots/EtaSq_",
      output_name,
      ".pdf"
    )
  )

  barplot(
    eta_df$partial_eta_sq,
    names.arg = eta_df$Effect,
    ylim = c(0, 1),
    ylab = expression(eta[p]^2),
    main = paste(
      "Partial eta squared -",
      output_name
    )
  )

  dev.off()

  # =========================
  # DESCRIPTIVE STATISTICS
  # =========================
  descriptive_df <- data %>%
    group_by(across(all_of(factors))) %>%
    summarise(
      n = dplyr::n(),
      Mean = mean(.data[[response]], na.rm = TRUE),
      SD = sd(.data[[response]], na.rm = TRUE),
      SE = SD / sqrt(n),
      t_value = qt(0.975, df = n - 1),
      CI95_low = Mean - t_value * SE,
      CI95_high = Mean + t_value * SE,
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(-t_value)

  write.csv(
    descriptive_df,
    paste0(outdir, "/Tables/Descriptive_", output_name, ".csv"),
    row.names = FALSE
  )

  # =========================
  # ASSUMPTIONS
  # =========================
  shapiro_res <- shapiro.test(residuals(model))

  levene_res <- car::leveneTest(formula_factors, data = data)

  capture.output(
    shapiro_res,
    file = paste0(outdir, "/Tables/Shapiro_", output_name, ".txt")
  )

  write.csv(
    as.data.frame(levene_res),
    paste0(outdir, "/Tables/Levene_", output_name, ".csv"),
    row.names = FALSE
  )

  # =========================
  # QQ PLOT
  # =========================
  pdf(paste0(outdir, "/Plots/QQplot_", output_name, ".pdf"))

  qqnorm(
    residuals(model),
    main = paste("QQ plot residuals -", output_name)
  )
  qqline(residuals(model), col = "red")

  dev.off()

  # =========================
  # TUKEY
  # =========================

  p_vals <- anova(model)[, "Pr(>F)"]

  # Only consider experimental effects, not Block
  experimental_terms <- c(
    factors,
    paste(factors, collapse = ":")
  )

  is_significant <- any(
    p_vals[rownames(anova(model)) %in% experimental_terms] < 0.05,
    na.rm = TRUE
  )

  if (is_significant) {

    # Estimated marginal means for all treatment combinations
    emm <- emmeans::emmeans(
      model,
      specs = as.formula(
        paste("~", paste(factors, collapse = " * "))
      )
    )

    # Tukey pairwise comparisons
    tuk <- pairs(
      emm,
      adjust = "tukey"
    )

    write.csv(
      as.data.frame(tuk),
      paste0(outdir, "/Tables/Tukey_", output_name, ".csv"),
      row.names = FALSE
    )

    # Compact letter display
    letters <- multcomp::cld(
      emm,
      adjust = "tukey",
      Letters = letters,
      sort = FALSE
    )

    # Build interaction identifier
    letters_df <- as.data.frame(letters)

    letters_df$Interaction <- do.call(
      interaction,
      c(letters_df[factors], sep = ":")
    )

    letters_df$Letters <- trimws(letters_df$.group)

    # Position for plot
    ypos <- data %>%
      group_by(across(all_of(factors))) %>%
      summarise(
        ypos = max(
          .data[[response]],
          na.rm = TRUE
        ) +
          tukey_padding *
          diff(range(.data[[response]], na.rm = TRUE)),
        .groups = "drop"
      ) %>%
      mutate(
        Interaction = do.call(
          interaction,
          c(across(all_of(factors)), sep = ":")
        )
      )

    letters_df <- left_join(
      letters_df,
      ypos %>% dplyr::select(Interaction, ypos),
      by = "Interaction"
    )  

    letters_df$Tissue <- output_name

    write.csv(
      letters_df,
      paste0(outdir, "/Tables/Letters_", output_name, ".csv"),
      row.names = FALSE
    )

  } else {

   tuk <- NULL

    letters_df <- data.frame(
      Interaction = NA,
      Letters = NA,
      ypos = NA,
      Tissue = output_name
    )
  }
  # =========================
  # RETURN
  # =========================
  return(list(
    model = model,
    tukey = tuk,
    letters = letters_df,
    eta_sq = eta_df
  ))
}

fdr <- function(aerial, roots, effect){

  p <- c(
    aerial[effect, "Pr(>F)"],
    roots[effect, "Pr(>F)"]
  )

  p.adjust(p, method = "fdr")
}

plot_violin <- function(
    data,
    model,
    response,
    ylabel,
    letters_df,
    treatment_colors = NULL,
    facet_var = NULL,
    facet_direction = c("rows", "cols"),
    treatment_labels = NULL,   # ex: c(Volume = "mL", MS = "MS strength")
    level_labels = NULL,        # ex: c(Prs = "+", Abs = "-")
    padding_label = c(0.03, 0.20),
    p_adj = NULL
){

  anova_res <- summary(model)[[1]][c(1,2,4), ]

  if (is.null(p_adj)) {

    # standard ANOVA p-values
    p_values <- anova_res[, "Pr(>F)"]

  } else {

    # use FDR-corrected values
    if (!"FDR" %in% colnames(p_adj)) {
      stop("p_adj doit contenir une colonne 'FDR'")
    }

    p_values <- p_adj[
      rownames(anova_res),
      "FDR"
    ]

  }

  p_label <- paste0(
    stringr::str_pad(trimws(rownames(anova_res)), width = max(nchar(trimws(rownames(anova_res)))), side  = "right"),
    ": p = ",
    signif(p_values, 3),
    collapse = "\n"
  )

  factors      <- attr(terms(model)[c(1,2,4)], "term.labels")
  main_factors <- factors[!grepl(":", factors)]   # order = order in Interaction
  x_label      <- paste(main_factors, collapse = " × ")

  # --- Detect an empty / non-significant letters_df (all NA) ---
  if (!is.null(letters_df)) {
    if (nrow(letters_df) == 0 || all(is.na(letters_df$Interaction))) {
      letters_df <- NULL
    }
  }

  # --- Enrich letters_df with facet_var if absent ---
  if (!is.null(facet_var) && !is.null(letters_df) && !facet_var %in% colnames(letters_df)) {

    interaction_facet_map <- data %>%
      dplyr::select(dplyr::all_of(c("Interaction", facet_var))) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(dplyr::across(everything(), as.character)) %>%
      dplyr::distinct()

    letters_df <- letters_df %>%
      dplyr::mutate(Interaction = as.character(Interaction)) %>%
      dplyr::left_join(interaction_facet_map, by = "Interaction")
  }

  # --- Filter letters_df: keep only interactions from the correct facet ---
  if (!is.null(facet_var) && !is.null(letters_df) && facet_var %in% colnames(letters_df)) {
    letters_df <- letters_df %>%
      dplyr::filter(
        as.character(.data[[facet_var]]) ==
          as.character(data[[facet_var]][match(Interaction, data$Interaction)])
      )
  }

  # --- helper: escape sensitive markdown characters (avoids <ul> bug) ---
  escape_md <- function(x) {
    gsub("([*+_#-])", "\\\\\\1", x)
  }

  # --- helper: apply level_labels to a raw value if provided ---
  apply_level_label <- function(x) {
    if (is.null(level_labels)) return(x)
    out <- as.character(x)
    matched <- out %in% names(level_labels)
    out[matched] <- level_labels[out[matched]]
    out <- escape_md(out)
    out
  }

  # --- X-axis label: keep only the factor NOT used as facet_var ---
  # main_factors is in the same order as the parts of Interaction (separated by ":")
  axis_factor <- if (!is.null(facet_var) && facet_var %in% main_factors) {
    setdiff(main_factors, facet_var)
  } else {
    main_factors
  }

  if (!is.null(facet_var) && length(main_factors) == 2 && facet_var %in% main_factors) {

    facet_pos <- which(main_factors == facet_var)
    axis_pos  <- setdiff(seq_along(main_factors), facet_pos)

    data <- data %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        .axis_value = sapply(
          strsplit(as.character(Interaction), ":"),
          function(x) x[axis_pos]
        )
      )

    # --- apply level_labels (e.g. Prs -> +) BEFORE the treatment_labels suffix ---
    data <- data %>%
      dplyr::mutate(.axis_value = apply_level_label(.axis_value))

    # apply custom label (e.g. "*T. asperellum*") if provided — markdown allowed
    axis_suffix <- if (!is.null(treatment_labels) && axis_factor %in% names(treatment_labels)) {
      treatment_labels[[axis_factor]]
    } else {
      ""
    }

    data <- data %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        .axis_label = paste0(.axis_value, ifelse(axis_suffix == "", "", paste0(" ", axis_suffix)))
      )

    # order x-axis labels according to the order of appearance of Interaction
    axis_order <- data %>%
      dplyr::distinct(Interaction, .axis_label) %>%
      dplyr::arrange(Interaction) %>%
      dplyr::pull(.axis_label) %>%
      unique()

    data$.axis_label <- factor(data$.axis_label, levels = axis_order)

    x_aes_var <- ".axis_label"

  } else {
    x_aes_var <- "Interaction"
  }

  # --- adaptive plot height #TODO: fix bug "Removed 1 row containing missing values or values outside the scale range (`geom_point()`). -> when point outside of scale range, force the plot and increase the scale-range"
  # Determine the maximum height to display
  ymax_data <- max(data[[response]], na.rm = TRUE)

  if (!is.null(letters_df)) {
    ymax_letters <- max(letters_df$ypos, na.rm = TRUE)
    ymax <- max(ymax_data, ymax_letters)
  } else {
    ymax <- ymax_data
  }

  ymin   <- min(data[[response]], na.rm = TRUE)
  yrange <- ymax - ymin
  padding <- padding_label[1] * yrange

  p <- ggplot(
    data,
    aes(x = .data[[x_aes_var]], y = .data[[response]], fill = Interaction)
  ) +
    geom_boxplot(width = 0.15, outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0) +
    geom_jitter(
      aes(color = Interaction),
      width = 0.12, alpha = 0.7, size = 4, show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(ymin, ymax + padding_label[2] * yrange + padding), expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0))) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 20) +     # --- base size increased for PowerPoint ---
    theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      axis.text.x  = ggtext::element_markdown(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 24),
      axis.text.y  = element_text(size = 24),
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 26, face = "bold"),
      axis.title.x = if (!is.null(facet_var)) element_blank() else element_text(size = 26, face = "bold"),
      strip.text   = ggtext::element_markdown(size = 24, face = "bold")
    ) +
    labs(
      x = if (!is.null(facet_var)) NULL else paste0("Treatment (", x_label, ")"),
      y = ylabel
    )

  # --- Tukey letters ---
  if (!is.null(letters_df)) {

    if (x_aes_var == ".axis_label") {
      letters_df <- letters_df %>%
        dplyr::left_join(
          data %>% dplyr::distinct(Interaction, .axis_label),
          by = "Interaction"
        )
      p <- p + geom_text(
        data = letters_df,
        aes(x = .axis_label, y = ypos, label = Letters),
        inherit.aes = FALSE,
        size = 7
      )
    } else {
      p <- p + geom_text(
        data = letters_df,
        aes(x = Interaction, y = ypos, label = Letters),
        inherit.aes = FALSE,
        size = 7
      )
    }
  }

  # --- Colors ---
  if (!is.null(treatment_colors)) {
    p <- p +
      scale_color_manual(values = treatment_colors) +
      scale_fill_manual(values  = treatment_colors)
  }

  # --- Facet + P-val ---
  facet_direction <- match.arg(facet_direction)

  if (!is.null(facet_var)) {

    # build custom labels for the facet strip
    facet_levels_raw <- sort(unique(as.character(data[[facet_var]])))

    # --- apply level_labels (e.g. Prs -> +) to the facet value, escaped ---
    facet_levels_display <- apply_level_label(facet_levels_raw)

    if (!is.null(treatment_labels) && facet_var %in% names(treatment_labels)) {
      facet_suffix  <- treatment_labels[[facet_var]]
      facet_labeller <- setNames(
        paste0(facet_levels_display, " ", facet_suffix),
        facet_levels_raw
      )
    } else {
      facet_labeller <- setNames(facet_levels_display, facet_levels_raw)
    }

    if (facet_direction == "rows") {
      p <- p + facet_grid(
        rows = vars(.data[[facet_var]]),
        scales = "free_x",
        space = "free_x",
        labeller = labeller(.rows = facet_labeller)
      )
    } else {
      p <- p + facet_grid(
        cols = vars(.data[[facet_var]]),
        scales = "free_x",
        space = "free_x",
        labeller = labeller(.cols = facet_labeller)
      )
    }

    first_facet <- facet_levels_raw[1]

    ann_df <- data.frame(label = p_label, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    ann_df[[facet_var]] <- first_facet

    p <- p + geom_label(
      data = ann_df,
      aes(label = label),
      x = -Inf,
      y = Inf,
      hjust = -0.05,
      vjust = 1.1,
      size = 7,            # --- enlarged for PowerPoint ---
      fill = "white",
      alpha = 0.9
    )

  } else {

    p <- p + annotate(
      "label",
      x = -Inf, y = Inf,
      label = p_label,
      hjust = -0.05, vjust = 1.1,
      size  = 7,
      fill  = "white",
      alpha = 0.9
    )
  }

  return(p)
}

# --- power analysis TODO: add to run() 
power_from_eta_sq <- function(eta_df,
                              alpha = 0.05,
                              power = 0.80,
                              k = 2,
                              effects = c("MicB", "MicP", "MicB:MicP")) {

  # keep only the requested effects
  eta_df <- eta_df[eta_df$Effect %in% effects, ]

  # conversion from eta² -> f
  eta_df$f <- sqrt(eta_df$partial_eta_sq / (1 - eta_df$partial_eta_sq))

  # power analysis for each effect
  res <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(eta_df)), function(i) {

    eff <- eta_df$Effect[i]
    f   <- eta_df$f[i]

    # ANOVA 2 groups (MicB or MicP isolated)
    pwr_out <- pwr.anova.test(
      k = k,
      f = f,
      sig.level = alpha,
      power = power
    )

    data.frame(
      Effect = eff,
      eta_sq = eta_df$partial_eta_sq[i],
      f = f,
      n_per_group = ceiling(pwr_out$n),
      total_n = ceiling(pwr_out$n) * k
    )
  })

  do.call(rbind, res)
}
```

```{r} 
aerial <- read.csv("Data/Exp1/aerialbiomass.csv")
roots  <- read.csv("Data/Exp1/rootsbiomass.csv")

aerial$Tissue <- "Aerial"
roots$Tissue  <- "Roots"

colnames(aerial)[1] <- "Biomass"
colnames(roots)[1]  <- "Biomass"

df <- bind_rows(aerial, roots)

df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    MicB = factor(MicB),
    MicP = factor(MicP),
    Tissue = factor(Tissue),
    Block = factor(Block),
    Interaction = interaction(MicB, MicP, sep = ":")
  )

# =========================
# RUN
# =========================
res_aerial <- run(
  df %>% filter(Tissue == "Aerial"),
  "Biomass",
  "Aerial",
  c("MicB", "MicP"),
  "Results/Exp1"
)

res_roots <- run(
  df %>% filter(Tissue == "Roots"),
  "Biomass",
  "Roots",
  c("MicB", "MicP"),
  "Results/Exp1"
)

anova_aerial <- as.data.frame(summary(res_aerial$model)[[1]])
anova_roots  <- as.data.frame(summary(res_roots$model)[[1]])

anova_aerial$FDR <- NA
anova_roots$FDR <- NA

effects <- c(rownames(anova_aerial)[c(1,2,4)])

for(effect in effects){
  
  adj <- fdr(
    anova_aerial,
    anova_roots,
    effect
  )
  
  anova_aerial[effect, "FDR"] <- adj[1]
  anova_roots[effect, "FDR"] <- adj[2]
}

write.csv(
  anova_aerial,
  "Results/Exp1/Tables/ANOVA_Arial_FDR.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)

write.csv(
  anova_roots,
  "Results/Exp1/Tables/ANOVA_Roots_FDR.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)

# treatment_colors <- c(
#   "Abs:Abs" = adjust_ltc(ploen, amount = -25, which = c(3, 4))[4],
#   "Prs:Abs"    = ltc("ploen")[1], 
#   "Abs:Prs"    = adjust_ltc(ploen, amount = +25, which = c(3, 4))[5], 
#   "Prs:Prs"   = adjust_ltc(ploen, amount = -25, which = c(3, 4))[3]  
# )

treatment_colors <- c(
  "Abs:Abs" = ltc("alger")[1],
  "Prs:Abs"    = ltc("alger")[2], 
  "Abs:Prs"    = ltc("alger")[5], 
  "Prs:Prs"   = ltc("alger")[4]
)

p_aerial <- plot_violin(
  df %>% filter(Tissue == "Aerial"),
  res_aerial$model,
  "Biomass",
  "Shoot biomass(mg)",
  res_aerial$letters,
  treatment_colors = treatment_colors,
  facet_var = "MicP",
  facet_direction = "cols",
  treatment_labels = c(MicB = "*T.asperellum*", MicP = "*R.solani*"),
  level_labels = c(Prs = "+", Abs = "-"),
  p_adj = anova_aerial
)

p_roots <- plot_violin(
  df %>% filter(Tissue == "Roots"),
  res_roots$model,
  "Biomass",
  "Roots biomass(mg)",
  res_roots$letters,
  treatment_colors = treatment_colors,
  facet_var = "MicP",
  facet_direction = "cols",
  treatment_labels = c(MicB = "*T.asperellum*", MicP = "*R.solani*"),
  level_labels = c(Prs = "+", Abs = "-"),
  p_adj = anova_roots
)

p <- p_aerial | p_roots

ggsave(
  filename = "Results/Exp1/Plots/Biomass_boxplot_pres.pdf",
  plot = p,
  width = 26,
  height = 20
)

ggsave(
  filename = "Results/Exp1/Plots/Biomass_boxplot_text.pdf",
  plot = p,
  width = 17,
  height = 14
)

ggsave(
  filename = "Results/Exp1/Plots/Biomass_boxplot_text.pdf",
  plot = p,
  width = 17,
  height = 10
)

# =========================
# SAVE FULL DATA
# =========================
write.csv(df,
          "Results/Exp1/Tables/Full_dataset_clean.csv",
          row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r}
  "MicB",

  "avg_diameter",
  "Block"
)

df$MicP <- factor(df$MicP)
df$Block <- factor(df$Block)
df$Interaction <- interaction(df$MicB, df$MicP, sep = ":")

res_diam <- run(df, "avg_diameter", "avg_diameter", factors = c("MicB", "MicP"), "Results/Exp2/Rhizo")

anova_diam  <- as.data.frame(summary(res_diam$model)[[1]])

anova_diam$FDR <- NA
```
